evals.prompt: I'm 22 weeks pregnant, been lifting for 5 years, OB says keep training. What changes now?
evals.expected_output: Applies second-trimester rules: removes supine and prone work, swaps to incline/sumo/trap bar, uses talk test not a 140 bpm cap, drills exhale-on-exertion, and monitors for coning.

evals.prompt: Had my baby 4 weeks ago (vaginal delivery), feeling good, want to start getting my fitness back and lose the baby weight fast.
evals.expected_output: Holds the line at weeks 0–6: walking, breathing, pelvic floor connection only; explains why; sets up the 6-week clearance and pelvic-floor check; caps any future deficit if breastfeeding.
